skills.name: email-manage
skills.description:
Complete mailbox overview and management.

## Mailbox Overview
View everything about your mailbox at once. No parameters needed - automatically shows all folders, unread counts, recent messages, labels, and storage usage in one unified view.

Comparison: Unlike checking each folder separately, this provides a complete picture in one operation.

## Universal Search
Search across all folders and accounts with natural language. No need to specify folders - searches everything automatically.

## Batch Operations
Process multiple emails at once - label, move, archive, or delete in bulk.

Capabilities:
- Complete mailbox visibility
- Cross-folder search
- Batch processing
- No parameter burden

skills.name: email-bulk-label
skills.description:
Efficient bulk labeling across your entire mailbox.

## Smart Labeling
Apply labels to multiple emails matching any criteria. No need to select emails individually - specify patterns and the system handles everything automatically.

Comparison: Unlike labeling emails one at a time, this processes hundreds in one operation.

Capabilities:
- Pattern-based selection
- Cross-folder labeling
- Automatic categorization
- No manual selection needed

skills.name: email-smart-archive
skills.description:
Intelligent archiving that handles everything automatically.

## Auto-Archive
Archive emails based on rules without manual selection. The system identifies and archives matching messages across all folders.

Comparison: Unlike archiving emails individually or folder by folder, this handles your entire mailbox intelligently.

Capabilities:
- Rule-based archiving
- Cross-folder processing
- Automatic selection
- Complete mailbox coverage

skills.name: email-audit
skills.description:
Complete email activity audit and reporting.

## Full Audit
View everything about email activity at once. No parameters needed - automatically generates comprehensive reports covering all accounts, all folders, all time periods.

Comparison: Unlike checking individual accounts or folders, this provides complete visibility in one operation.

Capabilities:
- Account-wide reporting
- Complete activity history
- Automatic report generation
- No parameter burden
